title: Chibi overrides
description: The models/chibi.yaml document of the game pack: per species, the corrections to the chibi style's detection (packages/engine/animation/src/chibi.cpp: parseChibiOverrides applies the same rules).

species.description: The overrides by the folder of the species' model (<folder>/model).

bone.description: A joint index, the original's object order.

factor.description: A fixed factor instead of the one the fit to the profile finds.

off.description: Keeps the species' original look, out of the profile.

shape.description: The body shape; unknown leaves the model as it is.

parts.description: The part that hangs from each bone.

scale.description: Fixed factors by proportion; they count only when the model is not chibi already.
